races.paceDynamic: New Monarch and Billecart will serve the role of pace-setters, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead over this mile trip. The tempo should be honest rather than frantic given only two dedicated pace angles, allowing the race to develop into a proper test of stamina. Behind them, Andab, Jel Pepper, Alarming and Timeforshowcasing will track in prominent positions, while Padraig Dawn alone represents the hold-up contingent. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike but avoid the early duel — the pace will be solid enough to expose pure front runners but not so fierce as to set it up for a closer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between New Monarch and Billecart is honest but sustainable.
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will soften each other up sufficiently for the prominent trackers to pounce in the final furlong. Andab's class edge and Timeforshowcasing's fresh legs from a long break make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can establish a clear lead and dictate terms.
scenarios.body: New Monarch's recent Newmarket win suggests improved form and Oisin Murphy's booking for Andrew Balding indicates confidence. Billecart showed front running ability when winning at Haydock and could prove tough to peg back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Padraig Dawn From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly fierce between the front pair.
scenarios.body: The lone hold-up horse will benefit from a strong gallop that stretches the field and exposes those who race prominently. His maiden win was achieved from off the pace and Edward Greatrex's 5lb claim provides a weight advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire or face traffic problems.
scenarios.body: Alarming carries a 5lb penalty reduction through Rossa Ryan and showed improved form when winning at Newmarket last time. The Ralph Beckett yard's relatively quiet spell could mask a well-handicapped runner ready to strike.

watchPoints.text: New Monarch and Billecart must be monitored for how fiercely they contest the early lead as this will determine the entire race shape.
Jel Pepper returning from 181 days off represents a fitness risk despite Oliver Cole's usual preparation methods.
Timeforshowcasing also faces fitness questions after 191-day absence but his course record suggests Newcastle suits.
Padraig Dawn needs to be positioned within striking distance turning for home as he's the only hold-up horse in a small field.
Andab's 48-day break is less concerning for a Joseph O'Brien runner given their preparation methods with Continental horses.

races.paceDynamic: Silent Strike, Sparksmith, and Northern Empire will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this 6f championship handicap. With 6 horses wanting prominent positions (including Monarch's Gold, Jungle Ruler, Eternal Solace, Three Non Blondes, Justmyluck, and Saffron Dandy), expect significant congestion and scrimmaging through the first 2 furlongs before the field strings out. The genuine pace will test stamina reserves over this stiff 6f, with traffic problems likely to emerge 2-3f out as the prominent pack compresses. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and closers will have plenty to aim at in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a strong gallop and the prominent pack gets into trouble
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will string out the field and create ideal conditions for the closers to pick off tired leaders. Ten Carat Harry and Al Najashi are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactics prevail
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure a clean passage through the early congestion
scenarios.body: A horse like Jungle Ruler or Three Non Blondes could capitalize on their tactical speed to avoid trouble and strike when the leaders weaken. Their ability to sit handy but not commit too early becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Silent Strike or Sparksmith can dictate fractions and kick clear before the closers arrive
scenarios.body: The leader may benefit from controlling the pace and having enough left to resist late challenges. Silent Strike's consistent front-running form makes him the most likely to achieve this.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and burn out, allowing the prominent pack to take control
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with horses like Monarch's Gold able to dominate from the front of the chasing pack. This negates the closing kick of the hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Shallow is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure from the prominent runners. Carolina Jetstream, Callianassa, Paris Babe and Indigo Dream will track the pace but none are aggressive early types, allowing Shallow breathing room through the first half-mile. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Stateira, Powdering, Fouette, Bridget's View, Ziggy's Queen, Brazilian Rose) will be patient at the rear, setting up a cavalry charge in the straight. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to string out the field but controlled enough to leave plenty in reserve for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shallow sets steady fractions and the prominent group doesn't apply pressure
scenarios.body: The patient brigade gets the perfect setup with Stateira and Powdering having the class edge, while Brazilian Rose and Ziggy's Queen offer value angles with strong recent form. Murphy's booking of Stateira after 77 days suggests stable confidence in the Balding runner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking group can secure the perfect stalking position and kick clear
scenarios.body: Carolina Jetstream's progressive profile and De Aguiar's 1/8 recent strike rate make her the standout, while Callianassa has proven 7f form despite Ellison's poor current record. Both can capitalise if the hold-up horses leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shallow Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly modest and no sustained challenge materialises
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets soft fractions and Spencer's 0/9 record means the pace-setting role falls to Shallow by default, whose 91 TopSpeed suggests she has gears when in front. Saffie Osborne's 5lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a pure speed duel from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: All running styles converge in a blanket finish where TopSpeed ratings become paramount, favouring Paris Babe's 101 figure and Shallow's 91 rating. Watson's 5/21 record and Doyle's big-race experience could prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: Flight Plan will take them along at a steady tempo as the sole confirmed leader, with Chancellor, Storm Star, Blue Rc, First Principle and The Lost King likely to race prominently behind. The lack of natural pace pressure means Flight Plan can dictate terms and the early gallop may be moderate before quickening entering the final three furlongs. With nine horses carrying hold-up tactics, there's significant closing traffic behind a manageable early pace. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and patient hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to string out the field but not punishing enough to stop closers.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Chancellor, Blue Rc or First Principle can secure ideal positions tracking Flight Plan
scenarios.body: These horses avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent while having enough tactical speed to respond when the pace lifts. Their class and prominent running styles are perfectly suited to this pace dynamic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Flight Plan Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Flight Plan faces minimal pace pressure and can control fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The six-year-old gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear when the field is still organising behind, exploiting his front-running style perfectly. His recent form suggests he retains enough ability to make this pay.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic-Affected Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates severe interference in the straight
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start as horses struggle for racing room, allowing a moderate finisher to steal through. This chaotic finish could suit horses with the lowest expectations getting clear runs.

races.paceDynamic: Valiant Force is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely taking the field along at a controlled gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Pocklington, Sarab Star, El Bodon and Lakers will track within striking distance, but none are aggressive early types likely to challenge Valiant Force for the lead. With 9 of the 14 runners employing hold-up tactics, the field will become strung out as they settle behind the pace-setting group. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to expose the leaders, and the large contingent of closers will create a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The 9 hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks, with Ferrous, Marshman and Heathcliff perfectly positioned to capitalise. The leaders will have done too much work early and fade in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force gets an easy lead with the field settling too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Scrappy Mid-Division Finish

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with positioning crucial, favouring horses that can quicken from mid-division rather than those relying on sustained finishes. City House's recent 6f form suggests he could benefit from this scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Sax Appeal represents the sole confirmed front-runner in this marathon contest and should dictate throughout at a sustainable gallop without early pressure. With Tryfan, Prydwen, and Berkshire Sundance likely to settle prominently behind the leader, the early pace will be honest but not fierce. The majority of this field prefer to be held up, meaning the race will develop into a classic staying test with a strong gallop from the outset that will string out the field over the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the tactical scenario creates optimal conditions for late closers to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest and sustainable as expected...
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will suit the patient tactics of the numerous hold-up performers who can time their runs perfectly off the genuine pace. Duke Of Oxford, Enemy, and Dramatic Star all possess the class and finishing speed to capitalise when the race develops into a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tryfan or Prydwen can secure ideal positions tracking Sax Appeal...
scenarios.body: The prominent pair can avoid the traffic problems that may hinder the hold-up horses in a large field over this stamina-sapping trip. Tryfan's recent Chelmsford second and Berkshire Sundance's class under Oisin Murphy make them threats if positioned well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Sax Appeal gets an easy lead and the field fails to close...
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston-trained leader can steal a march if given too much rope early, with his proven stamina reserves allowing him to resist late challenges. Daniel Muscutt's patient ride could prove decisive if the pace judgement is perfect.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Sax Appeal goes too slowly and kills the race as a contest...
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where tactical speed matters more than stamina, potentially suiting horses with more natural pace. This scenario would be chaotic and hard to predict with such a large field.

watchPoints.text: Sax Appeal getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through the first mile he becomes very dangerous
Traffic problems in the straight affecting hold-up horses - large field could cause interference issues for late closers
Duke Of Oxford's fitness after 77-day layoff - any signs of rustiness would be concerning given his break
Tryfan's position turning in - if Fraser secures a prominent berth he could outrun his odds significantly
Enemy's jumping from the gates - needs to break cleanly to secure good early position for hold-up tactics
